$comment: 各方立場並列資料。事實只取自 reports/research/2026-11/housing-positions.md 中讀過原文的項目。verbatim=true 的引語都是研究檔標明逐字、且在來源頁看得到的字句；記者轉述與標題一律改成 stance 的間接敘述並標 reported。政黨只收 2024 總統大選公開政見、黨的官方新聞稿與間接轉述，不收 2026 年任何地方選舉候選人的政見或評比，也不收 2026 年黨籍立委與黨團的公開發言。描述立場不用形容詞定性。金管會 2025-09-04 令釋的來源網址取自 qingan.json。

coverageNote.zh: 這一頁的材料有幾個限制。官方原文多半抓不到，不少內容來自媒體報導，轉述與逐字引語分開標示。批評現行政策者的公開材料，比為現行政策辯護者的多，辯護新青安的學者材料這次沒有找到。政黨部分只收 2024 年總統大選的公開政見與黨的官方新聞稿，不含任何 2026 年地方選舉候選人的主張，所以國民黨與民眾黨各只有一兩段轉述，時代力量、綠黨與台灣基進在這個範圍內沒有收到材料。銀行業只有一家銀行的法說會間接轉述，社會住宅推動聯盟只有 2014 年的訴求。查不到的格子寫在各爭點的「沒有資料」欄，不用別人的說法代填。
coverageNote.en: This page has several limits. Official texts were mostly out of reach, so much comes from media reports, and paraphrase is kept apart from verbatim quotation. Public material critical of current policy outweighs material defending it, and no scholar defending the new Youth Loan was found. For parties we include only 2024 presidential-campaign positions and official party releases, and nothing from any 2026 local-election candidate; the KMT and TPP therefore have only one or two paraphrased items, and for the New Power Party, the Green Party and the Taiwan Statebuilding Party nothing was collected within that scope. Banks are represented by one bank's indirectly quoted investor briefing, and the Social Housing Advocacy Alliance only by its 2014 demands. Gaps are shown as 'no data' under each issue rather than filled with someone else's words.

stance.zh: 2014 年 10 月巢運新聞稿列出五項訴求：居住人權入憲、終結強拆迫遷；改革房產稅制、杜絕投機炒作；檢討公地法令、停建合宜住宅；廣建社宅達 5%、成立住宅法人；擴大租屋市場、制訂租賃專法。這是 2014 年的訴求，2026 年的主張本站沒有查到。

text.en: The DPP's 2023 release proposes moving the hoarding tax to national aggregation and raising the non-owner-occupied rate from 3.6% to 4.8%.

text.en: The DPP's 2023 release sets 250,000 social housing units and 250,000 leased-and-managed units by 2032.

text.en: Grandma Cui's Lu Ping-yi: opacity and an informal rental market persist, and the government can no longer treat leases purely as freedom of contract.

question.en: The scale and direction of rent subsidies

text.zh: 民進黨 2023 年新聞稿：「現行的租金補貼，將加大到每年50萬家戶的補貼量。」
text.en: The DPP's 2023 release: current rent subsidies will be expanded to 500,000 households a year.

source.title: 政府全力推動保障居住權，賴主席提居住正義三大對策，回應國人期待

text.zh: 國土署副署長朱慶倫：「透過多元興辦社宅、包租代管社宅及租金補貼3項政策，依社宅供給進度相互搭配，逐年依需求調整計畫戶數。」
text.en: Agency deputy director Chu Ching-lun: the three tools of social housing, leased-and-managed housing and rent subsidies are matched to supply progress, and planned household numbers are adjusted yearly to demand.

source.title: 民團質疑租補戶數至2032年砍半 國土署：滾動調整

text.zh: OURs 彭揚凱：「依照他們現在要實施的這個方案，未來每一年的租金補助戶數會下修」。
text.en: OURs' Peng Yang-kai: under the plan now to be implemented, the number of subsidised households will be revised down each year.

text.en: Central bank Governor Yang Chin-long (13 June 2024): as for loopholes, that is the Ministry of Finance's responsibility and the bank will not overstep.

source.title: 央行楊金龍曝新青安「衝擊房市」 第6波管制1關鍵未擴全台

text.zh: 財政部長莊翠雲（2026-06-10）：「寬限期最長5年，但是真正適用寬限期到5年的只有23%。」
text.en: Finance Minister Chuang Tsui-yun (10 June 2026): the grace period is at most five years, but only 23% actually use the full five.

source.title: 楊金龍宣布房市信用管制不加碼 營造股多數收紅

text.zh: 金管會（報導引述）：「公股銀確實有背負政策性放款，但法規規定3成，若分子不能調整，也可透過分行吸收存款來加大分母」。
text.en: FSC (quoted by CNA): state-owned banks do carry policy lending, but the rule caps it at 30%, and if the numerator cannot be adjusted the denominator can be enlarged by taking deposits at branches.

source.title: 房貸放款沒額度？金管會找8公股行庫溝通並嚴禁搭售

text.zh: 華南銀行消金副總黃守良（間接引述）：華銀的銀行法 72 條之 2 額度還夠，但受央行集中度影響較大。
text.en: Hua Nan Bank's consumer finance vice president (indirect quotation): the bank's Article 72-2 headroom is sufficient but the central bank's concentration rule weighs more.
